summary.text: Bret Shultz is the Republican candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 35 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Lisa Willner (D).
He won the May 19 Republican primary with 73.1% of the vote.

paragraphs.text: Shultz defeated Charles Jungbert, 931 votes to 342, in the 2026 Republican primary.
He was previously the Republican candidate for Louisville Metro Council District 21 in 2018, when he received 28.8% of the vote and Democrat Nicole George won.
